violation_type.title: Individual Cot, Bed, or Mat for Each Walking Child Through 4 Years of Age (26 TAC §747.4303(a))
violation_type.short_title: Individual Cot, Bed, or Mat for Each Walking Child Through 4 Years of Age
violation_type.typical_finding: Child was observed sleeping on the bed instead of on their individual cot or mat.

finding_variants.text: Child was observed sleeping on the bed instead of on their individual cot or mat.
During this inspection I observed two children sleeping on a sofa.
Children were observed napping on the sofa and not a non-absorbent mat or cot.
There were no washable mats/cots available for napping for walking children age 2 years during inspection.
A child that is walking was observed being put in a play yard for naptime.
Walking toddlers in care aren't sleeping on appropriate sleep equipment.
